Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-resolution landscape game UI design sheet for Rogue Drive: Survival, a PC post-apocalyptic road survival game. Cohesive professional art direction: charcoal painted sheet metal, restrained worn edges and screws, dusty warm ivory typography, muted amber interactive accents, oxide red errors, sage green healthy indicators. Industrial utility rather than fantasy, readable clean inner panels, subtle grime only at edges. Crisp Cyrillic Russian labels, strong visual hierarchy, generous spacing, realistic stylized item art compatible with low-poly game. Flat front-facing UI presentation, no perspective distortion, no watermarks. Sheet 01: comprehensive UI COMPONENT LIBRARY on dark background. Title 'ROGUE DRIVE / UI KIT'. Carefully organized rows: color swatches and typography; primary amber button 'ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ', secondary 'ОТМЕНА', destructive 'РАЗОБРАТЬ', disabled button; default hover pressed keyboard-focus states explicitly visually different; square icon buttons close back settings; tabs 'ВСЁ', 'РЕСУРСЫ', 'ДЕТАЛИ'; checkbox, toggle, slider, dropdown, scroll bar, input field; inventory slots empty occupied selected damaged locked; resource icons fuel coolant scrap ammo repair battery tire; compact tooltip with item image; progress bar and hold-to-interact ring; warning success info toasts; confirmation dialog; keycap E Esc Shift. Use short legible labels and visual examples instead of paragraphs. This must feel like a complete practical game UI kit, not a website.
